en: AMARIA: I'll be fine, don't worry...

en: And-- what ever happened to Cain?

en: We can't let Team Meteor get away with whatever they're plotting, but--

key: Would you go in my place?
en: Would you go in my place?

key: Maybe while you're there, you can pick up the Machine for Strength!
en: Maybe while you're there, you can pick up the Machine for Strength!

en: With that, and the badge to use it, you could clear the wreckage and reach the children.

en: Ah, but how to get there...

en: Here, you can take my boat.

en: It's the building right there.

key: Normally, I only use it for recreation, or for checking on the wildlife project on Azurine Island.

en: Help yourself, okay?

key: AMARIA: ...Hm.
en: AMARIA: ...Hm.

en: What that man said bothers me though...

en: And, Ace too.

en: A new systems admin known as "T"...

en: But then, they were just tricking us.

key: I can't believe they pretended to save my life just for that.
en: I can't believe they pretended to save my life just for that.

key: Aside from that, there's no way Tania could be involved with them.
en: Aside from that, there's no way Tania could be involved with them.

en: I know she wouldn't lie to me about something like that.

key: A lifetime both behind and ahead of us,
en: A lifetime both behind and ahead of us,

en: Of water, air, mist, and pulsing moonlight--
ja: 水と　空気と　霧と　脈打つ月明かりの日々――

key: A silken world pouring down marbled stairways of trust and promises...

ja: 信頼と約束の　大理石の階段を　流れ落ちる　絹のような世界……

en: We sat under the rain as it fell from a spotless starry sky, and I could have sworn not a wisp of it reached us.
ja: 曇りない星空から降る雨の下に　二人で座っていたけど　一滴も　わたしたちには　届かなかった気がする

key: The only thing we felt was precious lightning,
en: The only thing we felt was precious lightning,
ja: 感じたのは　いとしい稲妻だけ

key: Gently kissing our scars from head to toe.
en: Gently kissing our scars from head to toe.
ja: 頭からつま先まで　傷あとに　やさしく口づけていく

key: Silken sand was our embrace, every bead like god- sent glitter, decorating her perfect, soft skin...
en: Silken sand was our embrace, every bead like god- sent glitter, decorating her perfect, soft skin...

key: I'll treasure every single memory with her.
en: I'll treasure every single memory with her.

key: AMARIA: U-um, sorry, nevermind all that!
en: AMARIA: U-um, sorry, nevermind all that!
ja: アマリア: え　えっと　ごめん　今のは　忘れて!

key: I just get a little lost in her sometimes.
en: I just get a little lost in her sometimes.
ja: たまに　あの子のことで　夢中になっちゃうの

en: \PN, thanks for all your help, from the bottom of my heart.
ja: \PN　力を貸してくれて　心から　ありがとう

key: Good luck in Apophyll.
en: Good luck in Apophyll.

en: GRUNT: Uh, boss?

en: I will deal with them myself.

en: zeL: Um, I know you didn't ask, but--

en: ???: When we first met below the stairway, I assumed it was mere coincidence.
ja: ???: 階段の下で　初めて会ったときは　ただの偶然だと　思っていた

en: I understand that our meetings are not due to any semblance of chance.

en: A pattern of disrespect.

en: I do not take kindly to being disrespected.

en: You are fool enough to meddle in affairs well beyond your mettle,

en: zEl: ...

en: A toxin strong enough to chase humans away from an increasingly tainted land...

key: ???: Consider carefully if you wish to continue speaking out of line as you are.

en: Your spirit?

en: Or perhaps, much like this Muk which so desperately calls for your help,

key: AMARIA: Not on my watch!
en: AMARIA: Not on my watch!
ja: アマリア: そうはさせない!

key: I don't want to lose them...
en: I don't want to lose them...

key: SOLARIS: "Tania," is it?
en: SOLARIS: "Tania," is it?
ja: ソラリス: 「タニア」だと?

key: Hahaha...
en: Hahaha...
ja: ハハハ……

key: AMARIA: What's so funny?
en: AMARIA: What's so funny?
ja: アマリア: 何がおかしいの?

key: SOLARIS: Are you entirely sure you can trust this "Tania" of yours?
en: SOLARIS: Are you entirely sure you can trust this "Tania" of yours?
ja: ソラリス: その「タニア」とやらを　本当に信じられるのか?

key: She's the most important person in the world to me.

key: I wouldn't even be alive without her.
en: I wouldn't even be alive without her.

key: Anything she gives me is precious.
en: Anything she gives me is precious.

en: That's why I'll defend it to my dying breath!

key: SOLARIS: Hahahahaha...
